## Details

<a id="fireball_msb_set_mask"></a>
### [`fireball_msb_set_mask`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L7) `$42C5-$42C6`

*data*

Bit 8 masks of the sprite X positions for fireball 0 and 1 (sprites 6, 7): ORA values $40, $80 for MSIGX. Indexed by fireball number (0-1).

- **Read by:** [`update_fireballs`](../room/wizard_fireballs.md#update_fireballs)

<a id="fireball_msb_clear_mask"></a>
### [`fireball_msb_clear_mask`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L10) `$42C7-$42C8`

*data*

AND values $BF, $7F that clear bit 6/7 of MSIGX. Indexed by fireball number (0-1).

- **Read by:** [`update_fireballs`](../room/wizard_fireballs.md#update_fireballs)

<a id="option_two_players"></a>
### [`option_two_players`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L14) `$42C9`

*variable*

Game option F3: 0 = one player, 1 = two players who take turns. The title screen toggles it; the demo sets it to 0 and puts it back from option_two_players_saved.

- **Read by:** [`start_attract_demo`](title_demo_start.md#start_attract_demo), [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen), [`title_menu_loop`](title_menu.md#title_menu_loop), [`title_show_players_choice`](title_player_screens.md#title_show_players_choice), [`show_player_screen`](title_player_screens.md#show_player_screen), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update), [`lose_fall`](lose_fall_game_over.md#lose_fall), [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over)
- **Written by:** [`start_attract_demo`](title_demo_start.md#start_attract_demo), [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen), [`title_menu_loop`](title_menu.md#title_menu_loop)

<a id="option_yamo_player2"></a>
### [`option_yamo_player2`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L18) `$42CA`

*variable*

Game option F5: 0 = the computer controls Yamo, 1 = player 2 controls Yamo. The title screen toggles it; copy in option_yamo_player2_saved. Also read by draw_room, the game start (9 falls) and the actor code.

- **Read by:** [`start_attract_demo`](title_demo_start.md#start_attract_demo), [`show_title_screen`](title_demo_start.md#show_title_screen), [`title_menu_loop`](title_menu.md#title_menu_loop), [`draw_room`](../room/draw_room.md#draw_room), [`update_yamo_spawn`](../actor/actor_spawn.md#update_yamo_spawn), [`reset_yamo_spawn_timer`](../actor/actor_spawn.md#reset_yamo_spawn_timer), [`update_ninja_spawn`](../actor/actor_spawn.md#update_ninja_spawn), [`title_show_opponent_choice`](title_player_screens.md#title_show_opponent_choice), [`init_game_variables`](game_setup.md#init_game_variables), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update), [`actor_continue_action`](../actor/actor_timed_actions.md#actor_continue_action), [`wake_idle_enemies`](../actor/actor_helpers.md#wake_idle_enemies)

<a id="game_over_letters_top"></a>
### [`game_over_letters_top`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L28) `$42CD-$42DE`

*data*

'GAME OVER' in big letters, top line: 18 char codes (2x2 chars for each letter, $5C = space). game_over_text_loop writes each code OR $80 to game_screen+$33 (screen row 1, column 11).

- **Read by:** [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over)

<a id="game_over_letters_bottom"></a>
### [`game_over_letters_bottom`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L34) `$42DF-$42F0`

*data*

'GAME OVER' in big letters, bottom line: 18 char codes, written OR $80 to game_screen+$5B (screen row 2, column 11).

- **Read by:** [`game_over`](lose_fall_game_over.md#game_over)

<a id="anim_char_patterns_low_rooms"></a>
### [`anim_char_patterns_low_rooms`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L41) `$42F1-$4308`

*data*

Pixel patterns of the animated chars $61, $62, $63 for rooms 0-9: 3 records of 8 bytes (one char each). animate_scrolling_chars copies them into the charset rotated by anim_chars_phase, so the pattern scrolls vertically. anim_chars_pattern_ptr points here.

- **Referred to by:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](../room/animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars)

<a id="anim_char_patterns_high_rooms"></a>
### [`anim_char_patterns_high_rooms`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L46) `$4309-$4320`

*data*

Pixel patterns of the animated chars $61, $62, $63 for rooms 10-19: 3 records of 8 bytes.

- **Referred to by:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](../room/animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars)

<a id="anim_chars_speed_step"></a>
### [`anim_chars_speed_step`](../../../../src/game/options_and_patterns.asm#L53) `$4321`

*variable*

Step of the speed curve of the animated chars (index 7..0 into anim_step_delay: 8, 6, 4, 2, 4, 6, 8 passes per step, then a pause). animate_scrolling_chars counts it down; below 0 it restarts at 7 and reverses anim_chars_direction. draw_room and the room handlers set it to 7 to restart the curve.

- **Read by:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](../room/animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars)
- **Written by:** [`draw_room`](../room/draw_room.md#draw_room), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](../room/animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars), [`room04_frame`](../room/room_frames_0_7.md#room04_frame), [`room08_frame`](../room/room_frames_8_11.md#room08_frame), [`room09_frame`](../room/room_frames_8_11.md#room09_frame), [`room11_frame`](../room/room_frames_8_11.md#room11_frame)
